title: Refresh affected transitive dependency resolutions within existing ranges
body:
The 2026-09-05 npm lockfile audit reports four affected transitive packages in the root dependency tree (three high, one moderate) and two in the UI tree (both high). All have fixes within the existing dependency ranges; no direct dependency declaration or major-version migration is needed.

Root paths:
- MCP SDK -> Ajv -> fast-uri 3.1.5; patched 3.1.6.
- MCP SDK -> Express/body-parser -> qs 6.15.2; patched 6.16.0.
- React-hooks ESLint plugin -> Babel -> browserslist 4.28.2; patched 4.28.7.
- Vitest -> Vite -> PostCSS -> nanoid 3.3.17; patched 3.3.18.

The UI independently locks the affected browserslist and nanoid versions. Source search found no direct use of these four package APIs in application code. This is a confirmed vulnerable dependency inventory, not a demonstrated game exploit.

Update only the affected transitive resolutions and required dependency metadata in the two lockfiles, preserve both package manifests, install into this lane's own real node_modules directories, and verify clean npm audits plus normal game/tooling/build behavior. Other lanes' shared dependencies must remain untouched.

Maintainer references checked:
- https://github.com/browserslist/browserslist/security/advisories/GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx
- https://github.com/browserslist/browserslist/releases/tag/4.28.7
- https://github.com/fastify/fast-uri/security/advisories/GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8
- https://github.com/fastify/fast-uri/releases/tag/v3.1.6
- https://github.com/ljharb/qs/security/advisories/GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g
- https://github.com/ai/nanoid/releases/tag/3.3.18

Run pre/post crawl, full health (including the census lane as a precaution for shared dependency resolution), UI production build and browser smoke, and independent review before landing.
